target_customer: Startup founders and founding sales teams
problem: CRMs need manual upkeep. Fixture reads emails, meetings and calls to keep deals current and suggests lookalike prospects.
business_model: B2B SaaS CRM; pricing not found, private beta

founders.name: Matt Riley
prior_employers: Y Combinator (Visiting Partner, W25 and S25)
previous_startups: Swiftype (YC W12), acquired by Elastic in November 2017

competitors.name: Attio
competitors.what: Flexible CRM repositioned around AI agents

competitors.name: Day AI
competitors.what: AI native CRM with meeting transcription
competitors.funding_then: $4M seed in 2024 and a reported $20M Series A led by Sequoia in February 2026 (secondary report)

technical_complexity.rationale: Standard SaaS plus LLM agents over email, calendar and call data; integrations and trust are the hard parts. Founders previously built and sold a search company.

defensibility.rationale: Data lock-in grows once deals live in the CRM, but many AI CRMs launched in the same window and agent compatibility lowers barriers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were adding agent features in 2026 per search coverage. No later outcome known.

market_need_then: Startups and agents-first teams wanted CRMs that update themselves; many 2026 funded entrants (Lightfield, Day AI, Attio's agent pivot) show demand and crowding.

branding.domain_note: Uses fixture.ai; acquisition history not found

identity.logo: Fixture logo, details not described by sources
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led: Talk to customers. Fixture does the rest.

branding.brand_signature: Talk to customers. Fixture does the rest.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline and a founder track record, but no press about the brand and a common English word; nothing shows brand pull.

outcome_analysis: Fixture is a Winter 2026 YC company run by Swiftype founders who sold to Elastic, which supports founder execution credibility. It enters a very crowded agentic CRM market with heavily funded peers. No outcome news exists and no verified funding round beyond YC was found.
notes: VCBacked lists a March 2026 pre-seed with Y Combinator as investor; an aggregator puts total raised around $500K. Both unverified and not recorded as rounds. Competitor dates are approximate (2026 coverage). Founder education not on YC page. One directory lists Fixture as London based, conflicting with YC page. Lightfield was seen in search but dropped from competitors because no dated source was found.
